decisions.note: Brief confirmed as written, no corrections (the owner's reply to the write-back was not scripted; the most conservative option was taken, per answer 13): Everyman with Caregiver; sincerity 0.9, excitement 0.4, competence 0.9, sophistication 0.4, ruggedness 0.6; industry tag 'invoicing for solo consultants' (fintech list).

Strategy approved as written (the owner's reply was not scripted; the most conservative option, per answer 13): one idea 'the piece that holds everything together'; combination mark, wordmark-led; avoid blue, green, slants, a bare letter in a tile, columns; own masonry, a grounded symmetric silhouette and an ember redder and darker than Chaser's orange.

Chose Hearth Stone, the warmer and denser board: Bricolage Grotesque 700 for the wordmark with Fraunces 600 beside it; Ember #c83c29 on Coal #221b17 and Kiln #f6eee3, Brick and Ash as support; heavy strokes, softened corners. Site Ledger (Sora, Archivo, greys with an ember spark) set aside.
Killed 03-dovetail after round 2: in a tile it is a figure in the category's container and reads as a bucket or keyhole at 32 px; out of the tile the joint draws a shirt collar; appropriate stays 3.

Killed 04-wordmark after round 1: the arched o carries the arch, not the piece that holds it, and a wordmark-only mark shows the whole word on every app icon from 96 px up, against the first surface; appropriate 3.

Name knock-out shown with the trademark caveat: an app named 'Keystone: Run Your Business' (VinTEK Solutions; vinteksolutions.com/keystone, App Store id6768339087) sells invoicing to solo service operators. Most conservative option (answer 13): keep the name as given and have a trademark attorney clear it before filing or spending.

First reaction to the concept sheet: 'the ring one looks like a loading spinner'. Probing question: what reads wrong, at what size, in which mockup? Answer: 'at the avatar size'. Sorted as a flaw (an unintended reading at a named size, the University of California 2012 loading-icon case), not unfamiliarity: 05-ring-gap is not carried forward.

Chose 02-arch, the direction whose symbol derives from the arch (answer 12 allows the K or the arch; 02-arch is the higher-scoring of the two, 43 against 37, the most conservative pick). Likes: none named beyond the choice (not scripted; most conservative answer). No steal from 01-k-jaw or 05-ring-gap; no blend.

Approved after the colour round (refine sheet round 1): 02-arch refined with a 5% heavier crown, a favicon redrawn on a 16 px grid, Bricolage Grotesque 700 tracked +10 with no quirk, stacked primary lockup with a 170-unit gap, Ember #c83c29 and Coal on Kiln, Ember Glow #ff8671 and Kiln on Coal.
